correctness.rationale: Direct basis expansion of the weight-zero Rota-Baxter identity gives the stated branches. In characteristic different from two, the nonzero-b branch has nonzero trace and cannot be nilpotent; the zero-b branch is exactly two square-zero planes. The automorphism group and conjugation formulas are derived explicitly, and finite-field exhaustive checks reproduce the locus and orbit counts.

value.rationale: Nilpotent Rota-Baxter operators are the explicit subject of the 2022 source section. Completing their locus and quotienting by automorphisms is a natural structural problem: the result finds a reducible two-plane geometry, proves uniform square-zero behavior, and compresses a quadratic finite-field operator set to a linear number of moduli classes.
